title: Federal rule: Appraisals for Higher-Priced Mortgage Loans Exemption Threshold
summary: Treasury Department / Comptroller of the Currency / Federal Reserve System / Consumer Financial Protection Bureau published the rule "Appraisals for Higher-Priced Mortgage Loans Exemption Threshold" in the Federal Register on 2025-12-16 (90 FR 58141), effective 2026-01-01.
